gavk_vandal_armies.armyName: Gothic and Vandal Kingdoms (Vandal Armies) 439 AD - 534 AD)

categories.name: Allies
categories.description: Alans (use Hun list) and/or up to two units of Berber Cavalry from the Early Byzantine list.

units.name: King
units.description: May ride a horse.

units.name: Noble
units.description: May ride a horse,

units.name: Comitatus Mounted
units.description: Mounted Comitatus have spear, light armour and shield. Superior Fighters. May have heavy armour (+1) May exchange spear for kontos (+1). The comitatus must be led by the Army General.

units.name: Elite Cavalry
units.description: Elite Cavalry have light armour, spear and shield. Superior Fighters. May have heavy armour (+1) and may either have javelins (+1) or exchange spear for kontos (+1).

units.name: Cavalry
units.description: Cavalry have spear and shield. Every second unit may have light armour (+1). Unarmoured cavarly may be field as Skirmishers.

units.name: Berber Cavalry
units.description: Berbers have javelins and shield. Skirmishers.

units.name: Warriors
units.description: Warriors have throwing spear and shield. Warband Rule 1. May be Riding Horses (+1).
